name: Gyöngyös (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the town arms of Gyöngyös (a blue shield with a black wolf, a crescent, a star and a sun within a yellow frame) below the name GYÖNGYÖS in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gyöngyös arms in a yellow frame
